title: The 14 Best Slow Cookers Under $50
metaDescription: Our 14 picks for slow cookers under $50, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at slow cookers under $50 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Crock-Pot 4-Quart Manual Slow Cooker SCV400-B
products.blurb: Key specs: 4-quart round stoneware insert, Low, warm, and high rotary knob settings, Removable, dishwasher-safe insert.
strengths: 4-quart insert is right-sized for 1-3 person households without wasted capacity
Simple rotary knob has no learning curve or menu to navigate
Removable stoneware insert is dishwasher safe
Crock-Pot's proven decades-old heating platform

No locking lid, not suitable for transport
Insert is not stovetop compatible
